correctness.rationale: PASS: For a marker-start word 1 0^a 1 0^b 1 0^c, every proper border must start at one of the two later markers; checking both yields unbordered iff a<c. Reversal gives zero-run start iff a>c. Interior same-symbol cuts have a one-letter border. Counting ordered three-gap compositions and dividing by marked-marker multiplicity yields M0,M2,M3 and moments. Independently enumerated 3,876 fixed-three-marker words for n=3..18 by direct prefix/suffix checks, matching cut predictions and count classes. The all-length algebra is the proof.
